key_idea: Follow the line from the arrow and say each shape as you go past it.
steps: Start at the purple arrow on the left and move right along the bottom part of the line.
First you pass the pink circle below the line. Then you reach the yellow square, just above and to the left of where the line turns up.
The line goes up and along the top. There you pass the green triangle.
Then the line goes down the right side, past the orange star. The order is circle, square, triangle, star.

choice_feedback.A: The pink circle starts further left than the square, so you pass it first.
choice_feedback.C: You pass the square before the line goes up to the triangle.
choice_feedback.D: This is the order going backwards, from the end of the line.
choice_feedback.E: You pass the triangle on the top part before the star on the right side.
